passages.fossil: A fos___ is preserved evidence of an organism from the geological past.
passages.mass-extinction: A mass ext_______ eliminates a large proportion of species over a relatively short geological interval.
passages.preserved-remains: Preserved rem____ can include ancient bones, shells, or other parts of organisms.
passages.trace-fossil: A trace fos___ records an organism's activity, such as a footprint or burrow, rather than its body.

questions.prompt: Paleontology: complete fos___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：sil → fossil。学習語：fossil。fossilは「化石」。地質時代の生物の遺骸や活動の証拠が保存されたものです。

questions.prompt: Paleontology: complete ext_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：inction → extinction。学習語：mass extinction。mass extinctionは「大量絶滅」。地質学的には短い期間に、多くの種が絶滅する出来事です。

questions.prompt: Paleontology: complete rem____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ains → remains。学習語：preserved remains。preserved remainsは「保存された遺骸」。昔の生物の骨・殻などが残ったものです。

questions.prompt: Paleontology: complete fos___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：sil → fossil。学習語：trace fossil。trace fossilは「生痕化石」。足跡や巣穴など、生物の体ではなく活動の痕跡を示す化石です。
